data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate strengthened prior year reserves by $2.6m during 2016 (2015: release of $2.9m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2016 with a gross claims outstanding opening balance of 327.6 (USD millions). Management states that it "strengthened prior year reserves by $2.6m during 2016", indicating an adverse movement (strengthening) equivalent to approximately 0.79% of opening gross claims. No specific prior-year accident years or named loss events are identified as the driver in the report text provided.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate strengthened prior year reserves by $2.6m during 2016 (2015: release of $2.9m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development taken from Managing Agent narrative sentence. The statement does not explicitly state whether the $2.6m is gross or net; it has been treated as a gross prior-year reserve strengthening (confidence 0.8). A gross claims development table is present but the PDF shows only development percentages and a single row of current gross claims liabilities (3623 share) by underwriting year; the triangle is therefore partial and was not used to recompute PYD. All monetary amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) despite field names referencing GBP.
